source.hypothesis: START allows FOLLOW assignment before RECON completes but does not allow FOLLOW launch while RECON is still on mission and has not returned. A simulation stop inside RECON's mission bounds must not be mistaken for predecessor failure or cancellation.

model.precedent: one fixed RECON starts hour 8, nominal duration 4, expected return hour 12 without failure
model.dependent: one fixed FOLLOW scheduled hour 10, nominal duration 2, may assign at hour 9
model.dependency: one explicit FOLLOW START depends on RECON at hour 8; paired control omits only this row and changes label
model.delta_from_parent: Control.SIMPE and RCEND 24 to 11 hours, plus provenance label; all other input fields remain inherited from accepted A13

predeclared_native_gate: The paired source inputs differ only in one MissionDependence START row and provenance label; each exact parent delta is recorded. The 13 control and 14 dependency populated source business tables must import and export exactly.

Fresh immutable session-0 SSH native runs use Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue and preserve GUI PID 13340/session/start identity. Source and raw outputs must be fingerprinted before and after execution.
Both runs convert with zero errors and produce valid SXO, native event logs, and 22 aligned half-hour System and Stock report bins for 0–11. A zero calc exit code alone is insufficient.

RECON must launch at 8 and remain on mission at the hour-11 stop, with no RECON completion, cancellation, failure, repair or logged success. If the engine truncates, completes or rejects it unexpectedly, the candidate is NO-GO for the planned unfinished-precedent comparison.

The no-row control must assign FOLLOW at 9 and launch it at 10; it is still nominally underway at the hour-11 stop. The START-row input must assign FOLLOW at 9 but not launch it by hour 11. No cancellation or failure may be silently called a successful wait; inspect individual events and report ledgers.

Every half-hour system and stock ledger, summary metric and terminal state must reconcile with the observed event timeline, including work still in progress at the stop. A separate read-only reviewer independently checks frozen source, closures and behavior without importing the author validator.
limits: This is an observation at one premature simulation stop, not evidence of what the engine would do after the stop or with a genuinely missing/never-returning precedent.

The inherited RECON MSUCPT=0.25 may mark internal success before hour 11 even though no success event is logged; this probe tests the separate return requirement, not failure to reach the success point.
No multiple precedents, other schedules, failures, cross-unit identities, GUI visual evidence or cross-engine parity are accepted.
